item: exit_evidence.native_in_flight: which wired native calls were open when the process ended (a 128-byte memory-mapped counter file)
summary: A plain store into a memory-mapped file survives abort(), SIGKILL and an OOM kill. The socket guard brackets dns and connect with native_call; lxml and duckdb are wired by their owners (patch files). The next boot reports in-flight counts at the last write (a lower bound), 'none-in-flight' (the abort ran in unwired code) or 'no-calls-recorded' as separate outcomes, and 'other-session' (counts never shown) when the file's pid or boot id is not the previous session's. Counts only, nothing to scrub. Worst case 161 B serialised against a 165 B budget.
